scripts.build: pnpm run build:client && pnpm run build:server
scripts.build:server: node scripts/bundle-server.mjs && node scripts/audit-server-bundle.mjs && node scripts/expose-appsscript.mjs && cp src/server/appsscript.json dist/apps-script/appsscript.json
scripts.build:worker:gateway: wrangler deploy --dry-run --outdir dist/worker-gateway --config wrangler.jsonc --env=staging-gateway && node scripts/audit-gateway-bundle.mjs dist/worker-gateway
scripts.check: tsc --noEmit && pnpm run typecheck:worker && eslint src vite.config.ts vitest.config.ts vitest.worker.config.ts --max-warnings=0
scripts.deploy:server: pnpm run build:server && clasp push --rootDir dist/apps-script
scripts.deploy: pnpm run build && pnpm run deploy:server
